title: Transforming readers
hints: Your `Read` doesn't produce bytes itself: let the wrapped reader fill the caller's buffer with `n, err := u.R.Read(p)`, then fix up the bytes in place.
Loop over `p[:n]` only (the rest of `p` is not data). Change the byte, then `return n, err` exactly as you got them — don't swallow `io.EOF` or other errors.
Upper: `if 'a' <= c && c <= 'z' { p[i] = c - ('a' - 'A') }`. ROT13: for lower case `'a' + (c-'a'+13)%26`, for upper case `'A' + (c-'A'+13)%26`, otherwise unchanged.
